card.text: Irregular outer moon of Pluto that spins about every 10 hours.

introduction.text: Hydra and Nix were found with Hubble in 2005. Hydra spins many times for each trip around Pluto and Charon.

model.title: Porter shape reconstruction
model.summary: A New Horizons shape fit; only the north was imaged, so the south is uncertain.
